verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents a REST API (docs-21) and an admin MCP server that grants AI tools write access to content and dashboard settings (docs-8), and the Enterprise tier lists RBAC for users (docs-61). Nothing in the evidence describes issuing scoped, read-only, or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. Since a SaaS platform with an API could plausibly offer this, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence yields "none".
